verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents its own multi-environment model, so a sandbox or staging environment can be used without touching production. Flags can be toggled per environment, environments are unlimited, release pipelines promote flags to production, and RBAC can restrict who modifies production environments. A full local Flagsmith instance can also be run via Docker. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that non-production environments isolate data from production, a dedicated sandbox or test-mode concept for agents, environment-scoped credentials for agent testing via MCP/CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
